summary: Add a field-preserving recipes update command backed by verified save-recipe operations.
reason: Paprika cleanup needs to repair recipe ingredients and preparation steps without rebuilding or silently clearing unrelated AnyList recipe metadata. Add explicit field-preserving updates, read-after-write verification by recipe ID, and cache synchronization only after a verified save.
validated_outcome: Registered recipes update with safe flags and stdin ingredient/preparation-step arrays, preserving omitted PBRecipe fields through clone-and-patch updates. Added parser, preservation, explicit-field verification, and cache read-back coverage; focused tests pass and no production recipe was mutated during validation.
